summary: A lightweight, production-ready FastAPI proxy and intelligent wrapper for Google's Gemini AI models, designed for seamless microservice integration with automatic fallback, function calling, and embedding generation.
key_features: Native function calling & structured argument extraction
Dedicated embedding generation endpoint for RAG/semantic search
Type-safe API contracts with Pydantic v2
achievements: Designed and implemented a resilient AI proxy with automatic model fallback to gracefully handle API failures and timeouts. Engineered complex function calling logic with tool declaration parsing and structured argument extraction. Built strict, type-safe request/response validation using Pydantic v2, ensuring data integrity and auto-generated OpenAPI documentation. Configured namespace-optimized, stdout-ready logging for seamless integration with Docker, systemd, and cloud observability stacks. Developed a flexible proxy routing architecture to enable secure deployment in restricted corporate network environments.
